Lines / Anchors affected: A5, CREASE1, CREASE2, CREASE3, CREASE4, M1; right-side anchors move with X_Right_Main
Required Behavior: When L changes, X_Right_Main = X_Left_Main + L; all right-side points move by Delta_L while left anchors stay fixed, keeping all line endpoints connected.

Lines / Anchors affected: B2, B4, G3, I3, CREASE6, CREASE9, CREASE13, CREASE16 and all vertically linked side anchors
Required Behavior: When W changes, Y_Cover_Bottom, Y_Base_Bottom, and related vertical anchors move so W-dependent lines stretch/shrink by Delta_W.

Lines / Anchors affected: C3, D3, E3, F3, H2, H3, J2, J3, CREASE11, CREASE12, CREASE14, CREASE15 and H-linked slanted/mirror anchors
Required Behavior: When H changes, all H primary and mirror/counterpart lines stretch/shrink by Delta_H. H2/H3/J2/J3 must not remain fixed; they are H mirror/counterpart lines and must keep connections closed.

Lines / Anchors affected: All points shared by multiple lines
Required Behavior: Every line endpoint is a Dynamic_Point. Connected lines reference the same point ID, so the system must not create independent endpoints that can separate.
Do not use global scale. Regenerate point coordinates from Inputs and line rules.

Delta Formula: C_AREA_Width = L_AREA_Height; at reference C/D/E/F straight width is 47mm, so width = 47 + Delta_H = H - 3
Lines / Anchors affected: C2, C4 and mirrored counterparts D2, D4, E4, E2, F2, F4
Required Behavior: C/D/E/F areas resize through the listed straight/slanted edges; slanted edges keep 12° by recalculating vertical offset from the dynamic horizontal width.
